# e2fsprogs — Vendored Sources

This directory should contain the e2fsprogs source tree subset needed to build `libext2fs`, `libet`, and `libsupport`.

## How to vendor

```bash
# In WSL2
git clone https://github.com/tytso/e2fsprogs.git e2fsprogs-upstream
cd e2fsprogs-upstream

# Run autogen if configure does not already exist
autoreconf -fi

# Copy required library subdirectories only (not the full repo):
for dir in lib/ext2fs lib/et lib/support include; do
    cp -r $dir /mnt/e/.../XIME.Tools/src/main/cpp/third_party/e2fsprogs/
done
cp configure /mnt/e/.../XIME.Tools/src/main/cpp/third_party/e2fsprogs/
```

After vendoring, run the WSL2 configure script to generate `android-config/<ABI>/config.h` and `ext2_types.h`:

```bash
bash XIME.Tools/scripts/wsl2_configure.sh
```

## Expected directory layout

```
third_party/e2fsprogs/
├── configure              # autoconf-generated
├── include/
│   └── ext2fs/
│       ├── ext2fs.h
│       └── ...
├── lib/
│   ├── ext2fs/            # main libext2fs sources
│   │   ├── ext2fs.h
│   │   ├── openfs.c
│   │   └── ...
│   ├── et/                # error table (com_err)
│   │   └── ...
│   └── support/           # shared utilities
│       └── ...
└── android-config/        # auto-generated by wsl2_configure.sh
    ├── arm64-v8a/
    │   ├── config.h
    │   └── ext2_types.h
    ├── armeabi-v7a/
    │   ├── config.h
    │   └── ext2_types.h
    ├── x86_64/
    │   ├── config.h
    │   └── ext2_types.h
    └── x86/
        ├── config.h
        └── ext2_types.h
```
